verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Linux, Linux driver releases, or driver release notes for Gaudi 3. It also contains no independent Linux testing of the part. The docs cover running a Docker image and PyTorch, DeepSpeed and vLLM workflows, but none of these establish documented Linux driver support. The community items discuss hardware specs, interconnect and benchmarks, not Linux driver behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, Linux is a first-class citizen for this GPU — documented Linux driver releases and independent Linux testing of this part
